### INPUT
#### clinical input
```{r}
### clinical
clin_dat <- as.data.frame(read_tsv(file = "./clinical.txt", col_names = T))
sur_dat <- as.data.frame(clin_dat) %>% 
  dplyr::select("Sample", "OS_5year", "Death_5year", "DFS_5year", "Relapse_Death_5year") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(`OS_5year` = as.numeric(`OS_5year`),
                `Death_5year` = as.numeric(`Death_5year`),
                `DFS_5year` = as.numeric(`DFS_5year`),
                `Relapse_Death_5year` = as.numeric(`Relapse_Death_5year`)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sur_os = survival::Surv(`OS_5year`, `Death_5year` == 1),
                sur_dfs = survival::Surv(`DFS_5year`, `Relapse_Death_5year` == 1)) %>% 
  dplyr::select("Sample", "sur_os", "sur_dfs")
rownames(sur_dat) <- sur_dat$Sample

clin_dat <- clin_dat %>% 
  dplyr::transmute(Sample = Sample,
                   Gender = ifelse(Gender == "Female", 0, ifelse(Gender == "Male", 1, NA)),
                   Age = as.numeric(Age),
                   `TNM_Stage` = as.numeric(factor(`Stage`, levels = c("I", "II", "III", "IV"), labels = c("I", "II", "III", "IV"))),
                   `Tumor_Left_Colon` = ifelse(`Location_3group` == "Left_colon", 1, 0),
                   `Tumor_Right_Colon` = ifelse(`Location_3group` == "Right_colon", 1, 0),
                   `Tumor_Rectum` = ifelse(`Location_3group` == "Rectum", 1, 0),
                   `CMS1` = ifelse(`Final_CMS` %in% c("CMS1"), 1, 0),
                   `CMS2` = ifelse(`Final_CMS` %in% c("CMS2"), 1, 0),
                   `CMS3` = ifelse(`Final_CMS` %in% c("CMS3"), 1, 0),
                   `CMS4` = ifelse(`Final_CMS` %in% c("CMS4"), 1, 0),
                   Hypermutation = ifelse(`Hypermutated` %in% c("hyper"), 1, 0),
                   `MSS` = ifelse(`GenomicSubtype` %in% c("MSS"), 1, 0),
                   `POLE` = ifelse(`GenomicSubtype` %in% c("POLE"), 1, 0),
                   `MSI` = ifelse(`GenomicSubtype` %in% c("MSI"), 1, 0),
                   TMB = as.numeric(TMB),
                   SVcount = as.numeric(SVcount),
                   `CIMP_Status` = ifelse(`CIMP_status` %in% c("CIMP"), 1, 0),
                   `Epimutation_Burden` = as.numeric(`Epimutation_burden`)
                   )


### Stages
clin_stages <- read.table("./CRC.Stages.txt",sep="\t",header=T,check.names=F)
clin_stages <- clin_stages %>%
  mutate(Sample=paste0(Normal,"-VS-",Tumor)
         )

save(sur_dat, clin_dat, clin_stages, file = "clindata_input.RData")



```

```{r}
clin_dat <- as.data.frame(read_tsv(file = "./clinical.txt", col_names = T))
methyl_input <- read.table("./allChr_wilcox_CpG.txt",sep="\t", header=T, check.names=F)
```

#### protein input
```{r}

################# protein ###
pro_dat <- as.data.frame(read_tsv(file = "./tumor_protein.txt", col_names = T))

pro_gene_match_tab <- as.data.frame(read_tsv(file = "./proteinName.txt", col_names = T))
pro_dat <- pro_dat %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(pro_gene_match_tab[, c("Gene", "Protein")], by = c("protein" = "Protein")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(is.na(`Gene`) == F)

pro_diff <- read.table("./protein_significant_wilcox_diff_tumor_normal.txt",sep="\t",header=T)

### MAD filtering 
############# find proteins with max MAD variation for each gene
mad_select_tab <- cbind(row_name = rownames(pro_dat),
                        mad = MatrixGenerics::rowMads(as.matrix(pro_dat[,2:(ncol(pro_dat)-1)])),
                        pro = pro_dat$protein,
                        gene = pro_dat$Gene
                        ) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  group_by(gene) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(mad == max(mad)) %>% 
  ungroup()

pro_dat <- pro_dat[mad_select_tab$row_name, ]
rownames(pro_dat) <- pro_dat$Gene
pro_dat <- pro_dat %>% 
  dplyr::select(-"protein", -"Gene") %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame()
pro_dat <- log2(pro_dat + 1)   #########   log2 transformed ###############
pro_dat <- pro_dat %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Sample = rownames(pro_dat))
rm(pro_gene_match_tab, mad_select_tab) 
colnames(pro_dat)[1:(ncol(pro_dat)-1)] <- str_c(colnames(pro_dat)[1:(ncol(pro_dat)-1)], "_pro", sep = "")
colnames(pro_dat) <- str_replace_all(colnames(pro_dat), pattern = "-", replacement = "_")

save(pro_dat, pro_diff, file = "protein.RData")


```

### FUNCTIONS
#### dfs uni cox function
```{r}
dfs_uni_cox <- function(tab_4_dfs_cox, dfs_covariates, cox_results_tsv, cox_results_rdata, model="sur_dfs") {
 
  univ_formulas <- sapply(dfs_covariates, function(x) {
    as.formula(paste(model," ~", x))
  })
  
  univ_models <- lapply(univ_formulas, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      coxph(x, data = tab_4_dfs_cox)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to fit model for", deparse(x), "\nError:", e$message))
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  valid_models <- !sapply(univ_models, is.null)
  univ_models <- univ_models[valid_models]
  univ_formulas <- univ_formulas[valid_models]
  
  univ_results <- lapply(univ_models, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      x_summary <- summary(x)
      
      p_value <- signif(x_summary$coefficients[1, 5], digits = 4)
      wald_test <- signif(x_summary$wald["test"], digits = 4)
      beta <- signif(x_summary$coefficients[1, 1], digits = 4)  
      HR <- signif(x_summary$coefficients[1, 2], digits = 4)  
      HR_conf_lower <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"], 4)
      HR_conf_upper <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"], 4)
      
      res <- c(
        beta = beta,
        HR = HR,
        HR_lower_95 = HR_conf_lower,
        HR_upper_95 = HR_conf_upper,
        wald_test = wald_test,
        p_value = p_value
      )
      
      return(res)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to extract results for model:", deparse(x$call)))
      return(rep(NA, 6))  
    })
  })
  
  cox_res <- t(as.data.frame(univ_results, check.names = FALSE))
  cox_res <- as.data.frame(cox_res)
  
  cox_res <- cox_res %>%
    mutate(factor = as.character(rownames(cox_res)))
  
  save(cox_res, univ_models, univ_formulas, dfs_covariates, file = cox_results_rdata)
  write.table(cox_res, file = cox_results_tsv, quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")
  
  return(cox_res)
}
save(dfs_uni_cox, file = "dfs_uni.cox.Rdata")


```
#### os uni cox function
```{r}
os_uni_cox <- function(tab_4_os_cox, os_covariates, cox_results_tsv, cox_results_rdata,model="sur_os") {
 
  univ_os_formulas <- sapply(os_covariates,function(x) as.formula(paste(model,' ~ ', x)))
  
  univ_os_models <- lapply(univ_os_formulas, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      coxph(x, data = tab_4_os_cox)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to fit model for", deparse(x), "\nError:", e$message))
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  univ_os_models <- univ_os_models[!sapply(univ_os_models, is.null)]
  univ_os_formulas <- univ_os_formulas[!sapply(univ_os_models, is.null)]
  
  univ_os_results <- lapply(univ_os_models, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      x_summary <- summary(x)
      p.value <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 5], digits = 4)
      wald.test <- signif(x_summary$wald["test"], digits = 4)
      beta <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 1], digits = 4)  # coeficient beta
      HR <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 2], digits = 4)    # exp(beta)
      HR.confint.lower <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"], 4)
      HR.confint.upper <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"], 4)
      res <- c(beta, HR, HR.confint.lower, HR.confint.upper, wald.test, p.value)
      names(res) <- c("beta", "HR", "HR_lower_95", "HR_upper_95", "wald.test", "p.value")
      return(res)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to extract results for model:", deparse(x$call)))
      return(rep(NA, 6)) 
    })
  })
  
  cox_os_res <- t(as.data.frame(univ_os_results, check.names = FALSE))
  cox_os_res <- as.data.frame(cox_os_res)
  cox_os_res <- cox_os_res %>%
    mutate(factor = as.character(rownames(cox_os_res)))
  
  save(os_covariates, cox_os_res, univ_os_models, univ_os_formulas, univ_os_results,file = cox_results_rdata)
  write.table(cox_os_res,file = cox_results_tsv,quote = FALSE,row.names = FALSE,sep = "\t")
  return(cox_os_res)
}

save(os_uni_cox, file = "os_uni.cox.Rdata")


```

#### dfs multi cox function
```{r}

dfs_multi_cox <- function(tab_4_dfs_cox, dfs_covariates, fixed_covariates=c("TNM_Stage", "Age", "Tumor_Left_Colon", "Tumor_Right_Colon", "Tumor_Rectum"), cox_results_tsv, cox_results_rdata, model="sur_dfs") {
 
  multv_formulas <- sapply(dfs_covariates, function(x) {
    as.formula(paste(model," ~ ", x, " + ", paste(fixed_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
  })
  
  multv_models <- lapply(multv_formulas, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      coxph(x, data = tab_4_dfs_cox)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to fit model for", deparse(x), "\nError:", e$message))
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  valid_models <- !sapply(multv_models, is.null)
  multv_models <- multv_models[valid_models]
  multv_formulas <- multv_formulas[valid_models]
  
  multv_results <- lapply(multv_models, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      x_summary <- summary(x)
      p.value <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 5], digits = 4)
      wald.test <- signif(x_summary$wald["test"], digits = 4)
      beta <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 1], digits = 4) 
      HR <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 2], digits = 4)    
      HR.confint.lower <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"], 4)
      HR.confint.upper <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"], 4)
      
      res <- c(
        beta, HR, HR.confint.lower, HR.confint.upper, 
        wald.test, p.value
      )
      names(res) <- c(
        "beta", "HR", "HR_lower_95", "HR_upper_95", 
        "wald.test", "p.value"
      )
      return(res)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to extract results for model:", deparse(x$call)))
      return(rep(NA, 6))  
    })
  })
  
  multi_cox_res <- t(as.data.frame(multv_results, check.names = FALSE))
  multi_cox_res <- as.data.frame(multi_cox_res)
  multi_cox_res <- multi_cox_res %>%
    mutate(factor = as.character(rownames(multi_cox_res)))
  
  save(multi_cox_res, multv_models, multv_formulas, dfs_covariates, file = cox_results_rdata)
  
  write.table(multi_cox_res, file = cox_results_tsv, quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")
  
  return(multi_cox_res)
}

save(dfs_multi_cox, file = "dfs_multi.cox.Rdata")

```

#### os multi cox function
```{r}

os_multi_cox <- function(tab_4_os_cox, os_covariates, fixed_covariates=c("TNM_Stage", "Age", "Tumor_Left_Colon", "Tumor_Right_Colon", "Tumor_Rectum"), cox_results_tsv, cox_results_rdata,model="sur_os") {

  multv_os_formulas <- sapply(os_covariates, function(x) {
    as.formula(paste(model,"~ ", x, " + ", paste(fixed_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
  })
  
  multv_os_models <- lapply(multv_os_formulas, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      coxph(x, data = tab_4_os_cox)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to fit model for", deparse(x), "\nError:", e$message))
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  valid_models <- !sapply(multv_os_models, is.null)
  multv_os_models <- multv_os_models[valid_models]
  multv_os_formulas <- multv_os_formulas[valid_models]
  
  multv_os_results <- lapply(multv_os_models, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      x_summary <- summary(x)
      p.value <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 5], digits = 4)
      wald.test <- signif(x_summary$wald["test"], digits = 4)
      beta <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 1], digits = 4) 
      HR <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 2], digits = 4)   
      HR.confint.lower <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"], 4)
      HR.confint.upper <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"], 4)
      
      res <- c(beta, HR, HR.confint.lower, HR.confint.upper, wald.test, p.value)
      names(res) <- c("beta", "HR", "HR_lower_95", "HR_upper_95", "wald.test", "p.value")
      return(res)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to extract results for model:", deparse(x$call)))
      return(rep(NA, 6))  
    })
  })
  
  multv_cox_os_res <- t(as.data.frame(multv_os_results, check.names = FALSE))
  multv_cox_os_res <- as.data.frame(multv_cox_os_res)
  multv_cox_os_res <- multv_cox_os_res %>%
    mutate(factor = as.character(rownames(multv_cox_os_res)))
  
  save(os_covariates, multv_cox_os_res, multv_os_models, multv_os_formulas, multv_os_results,file = cox_results_rdata)
  write.table(multv_cox_os_res, file = cox_results_tsv, quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")
  
  return(multv_cox_os_res)
}

save(os_multi_cox, file = "os_multi.cox.Rdata")



```

#### dfs & os uni_multi functions packing
```{r}
run_survival_analysis <- function(phos_data, clin_dat=clin_dat, sur_dat=sur_dat, patient_id= patient_id, output_prefix = "phos") {
   
  # Prepare DFS data
  tab_4_dfs_cox <- clin_dat[patient_id,] %>% 
    inner_join(phos_data, by = "Sample") %>% 
    inner_join(sur_dat[, c("Sample", "sur_dfs")], by = "Sample") 
  
  colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox))  
  colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox))  
  
  dfs_covariates <- colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox[,23:ncol(tab_4_dfs_cox)-1])
  
  # DFS Univariate Cox
  dfs_uni_tsv <- paste0(output_prefix, ".univariate.dfs.cox.phosphorylation.tsv")
  dfs_uni_rdata <- paste0(output_prefix, ".univariate.dfs.cox.phosphorylation.RData")
  dfs_results_uni <- dfs_uni_cox(
    tab_4_dfs_cox = tab_4_dfs_cox,
    dfs_covariates = dfs_covariates,
    cox_results_tsv = dfs_uni_tsv,
    cox_results_rdata = dfs_uni_rdata
  )
  
  # DFS Multivariate Cox
  dfs_multi_tsv <- paste0(output_prefix, ".multivariate.dfs.cox.phosphorylation.tsv")
  dfs_multi_rdata <- paste0(output_prefix, ".multivariate.dfs.cox.phosphorylation.RData")
  dfs_results_multi <- dfs_multi_cox(
    tab_4_dfs_cox = tab_4_dfs_cox,
    dfs_covariates = dfs_covariates,
    cox_results_tsv = dfs_multi_tsv,
    cox_results_rdata = dfs_multi_rdata
  )
  
  # 2. OS (Overall Survival) Analysis -------------------------------------
  
  # Prepare OS data (with numeric conversion)
  tab_4_os_cox <- clin_dat[patient_id,] %>%
    inner_join(phos_data, by = "Sample") %>% 
    inner_join(sur_dat[, c("Sample", "sur_os")], by = "Sample") 

  colnames(tab_4_os_cox) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(tab_4_os_cox))  
  colnames(tab_4_os_cox) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(tab_4_os_cox))  
  
  os_covariates <- colnames(tab_4_os_cox[,23:ncol(tab_4_os_cox)-1])
  
  # OS Univariate Cox
  os_uni_tsv <- paste0(output_prefix, ".univariate.os.cox.phosphorylation.tsv")
  os_uni_rdata <- paste0(output_prefix, ".univariate.os.cox.phosphorylation.RData")
  os_results_uni <- os_uni_cox(
    tab_4_os_cox = tab_4_os_cox,
    os_covariates = os_covariates,
    cox_results_tsv = os_uni_tsv,
    cox_results_rdata = os_uni_rdata
  )
  
  # OS Multivariate Cox
  os_multi_tsv <- paste0(output_prefix, ".multivariate.os.cox.phosphorylation.tsv")
  os_multi_rdata <- paste0(output_prefix, ".multivariate.os.cox.phosphorylation.RData")
  os_results_multi <- os_multi_cox(
    tab_4_os_cox = tab_4_os_cox,
    os_covariates = os_covariates,
    cox_results_tsv = os_multi_tsv,
    cox_results_rdata = os_multi_rdata
  )
  
  # Return results (optional)
  list(
    dfs_uni = dfs_results_uni,
    dfs_multi = dfs_results_multi,
    os_uni = os_results_uni,
    os_multi = os_results_multi
  )
}

save(run_survival_analysis, file="run_cox.function.Rdata")
```

##### DFS events distribution in different time interval
```{r}
load(file = "clindata_input.RData")



####### 4stages
sur_dat_1 <- merge(sur_dat,clin_dat[,c("Sample","TNM_Stage")])
sur_dat <- sur_dat_1 %>%
  rename(Stage=TNM_Stage) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Stage))

time_points <- c(12, 24, 36, 60)

status_data_stage <- lapply(time_points, function(t) {
  lapply(unique(sur_dat$Stage), function(s) {
    stage_data <- sur_dat %>% filter(Stage == s)
    status_at_t <- ifelse(stage_data$sur_dfs[,"time"] <= t & stage_data$sur_dfs[,"status"] == 1, 1, 0)
    status_at_t <- ifelse(stage_data$sur_dfs[,"time"] < t & stage_data$sur_dfs[,"status"] == 0, NA, status_at_t)
    
    data.frame(
      Sample = stage_data$Sample,
      Stage = s,
      Time = paste0(t, "months"),
      Status = factor(status_at_t, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No event", "Event"))
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% na.omit()

proportion_data_stage <- status_data_stage %>%
  group_by(Time, Stage, Status) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Time, Stage) %>%
  mutate(Proportion = Count / sum(Count),
         Time = factor(Time, levels = paste0(time_points, "months")))

p_grouped <- ggplot(proportion_data_stage, aes(x = Time, y = Proportion, fill = Status)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Stage, nrow = 1) +  
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Proportion * 100, 1), "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Event" = "#E74C3C", "No event" = "#3498DB")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "DFS Status Proportion by Stage and Time",
       x = "",
       y = "Proportion",
       fill = "Status") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")



####### detailed stages
sur_dat_1 <- merge(sur_dat,clin_stages[,c("Sample","TNM")],all.x=T)

sur_dat <- sur_dat_1 %>%
  rename(Stage=TNM) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Stage) & Stage!=0)

time_points <- c(12, 24, 36, 60)

status_data_stage <- lapply(time_points, function(t) {
  lapply(unique(sur_dat$Stage), function(s) {
    stage_data <- sur_dat %>% filter(Stage == s)
    
    status_at_t <- ifelse(stage_data$sur_dfs[,"time"] <= t & stage_data$sur_dfs[,"status"] == 1, 1, 0)
    status_at_t <- ifelse(stage_data$sur_dfs[,"time"] < t & stage_data$sur_dfs[,"status"] == 0, NA, status_at_t)
    
    data.frame(
      Sample = stage_data$Sample,
      Stage = s,
      Time = paste0(t, "months"),
      Status = factor(status_at_t, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No event", "Event"))
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% na.omit()

proportion_data_stage <- status_data_stage %>%
  group_by(Time, Stage, Status) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Time, Stage) %>%
  mutate(Proportion = Count / sum(Count),
         Time = factor(Time, levels = paste0(time_points, "months")))

p_grouped <- ggplot(proportion_data_stage, aes(x = Time, y = Proportion, fill = Status)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Stage, nrow = 1) +  
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Proportion * 100, 1), "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Event" = "#E74C3C", "No event" = "#3498DB")) +
```

```{r}
load(file = "protein.RData")
load(file="univariate.os.cox.protein.RData")
load(file="multivariate.os.cox.protein.RData")
rm(multv_os_models,multv_os_formulas,univ_os_formulas,univ_os_models,os_covariates,multv_os_results,univ_os_results)
load(file="univariate.dfs.cox.protein.RData")

rm(multv_formulas, multv_models,univ_formulas,univ_models,dfs_covariates)
### diff
pro_diff_formatted <- pro_diff %>%
  mutate(match_id=paste0(Gene,"_pro")) %>%
  mutate(match_id=gsub("-","_",match_id)) %>%
  mutate(match_id=gsub("/","_",match_id)) %>%
  filter(Gene!="")

#### Top 50%
colnames(pro_dat) <- gsub("/","_",colnames(pro_dat))
pro_mean <- pro_dat %>%
  select(-Sample) %>%
  colMeans()

pro_mean_df <- data.frame(
  Gene = names(pro_mean),
  pro_mean = as.numeric(pro_mean)
)

median_mean <- median(pro_mean_df$pro_mean)

pro_mean_df <- pro_mean_df %>% 
  mutate(group = ifelse(pro_mean > median_mean,"Top50%","."))

## merge
pro_diff_formatted_top50 <- merge(pro_diff_formatted, pro_mean_df, by.x="match_id",by.y="Gene", all=T)

cox_res_match <- merge( cox_res, pro_diff_formatted_top50[,c("wilcoxtest_log2FC","wilcox_FDR","Regulated","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

cox_os_res_match <- merge(cox_os_res, pro_diff_formatted_top50[,c("wilcoxtest_log2FC","wilcox_FDR","Regulated","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

multi_cox_res_match <- merge(multi_cox_res, pro_diff_formatted_top50[,c("wilcoxtest_log2FC","wilcox_FDR","Regulated","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

multi_cox_os_res_match <- merge(multv_cox_os_res, pro_diff_formatted_top50[,c("wilcoxtest_log2FC","wilcox_FDR","Regulated","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)
```

##### RNA diff and top50%
```{r}
load(file = "RNA_log2_plus1.RData")
load(file="univariate.dfs.cox.RNA.RData")
load(file="multivariate.dfs.cox.RNA.RData")
rm(multv_formulas, multv_models,univ_formulas,univ_models,dfs_covariates)
load(file="univariate.os.cox.RNA.RData")
load(file="multivariate.os.cox.RNA.RData")
rm(multv_os_models,multv_os_formulas,univ_os_formulas,univ_os_models,os_covariates,multv_os_results,univ_os_results)
gene_id <- read.table("human.gene2symbol_unique_biotype.txt",sep="\t",header=T)

### input formatted


df_formatted <- function(factor) {
  factor <- gsub("/","_",factor)
  factor <- gsub("-","_",factor)
  factor <- gsub(".","_",factor,fixed = T)
  return(factor)
}

colnames(exp_dat) <- df_formatted(colnames(exp_dat))
cox_res$factor  <- df_formatted(cox_res$factor)
cox_os_res$factor  <- df_formatted(cox_os_res$factor)
multi_cox_res$factor  <- df_formatted(multi_cox_res$factor)
multv_cox_os_res$factor  <- df_formatted(multv_cox_os_res$factor)

exp_diff_1 <- merge(exp_diff,gene_id[,c("GeneID","Symbol")], by.x="ENTREZID",by.y="GeneID")
### diff
exp_diff_formatted <- exp_diff_1 %>%
  filter(Symbol!="") %>%
  mutate(match_id=paste0(Symbol,"_exp")) %>%
  mutate(match_id=gsub("-","_",match_id)) %>%
  mutate(match_id=gsub("/","_",match_id)) 

#### Top 50%
exp_mean <- exp_dat %>%
  select(-Sample) %>%
  colMeans()

exp_mean_df <- data.frame(
  Gene = names(exp_mean),
  exp_mean = as.numeric(exp_mean),
  check.names=F
)

median_mean <- median(exp_mean_df$exp_mean)

exp_mean_df <- exp_mean_df %>% 
  mutate(group = ifelse(exp_mean > median_mean,"Top50%","."))

## merge
exp_diff_formatted_top50 <- merge(exp_diff_formatted, exp_mean_df, by.x="match_id",by.y="Gene", all=T)

cox_res_match <- merge(cox_res, exp_diff_formatted_top50[,c("log2FoldChange.Tumor.Normal.","Padj","Up.Down.Regulation","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

cox_os_res_match <- merge(cox_os_res, exp_diff_formatted_top50[,c("log2FoldChange.Tumor.Normal.","Padj","Up.Down.Regulation","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

multi_cox_res_match <- merge(multi_cox_res, exp_diff_formatted_top50[,c("log2FoldChange.Tumor.Normal.","Padj","Up.Down.Regulation","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

multi_cox_os_res_match <- merge(multv_cox_os_res, exp_diff_formatted_top50[,c("log2FoldChange.Tumor.Normal.","Padj","Up.Down.Regulation","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

#### save results
write.table(cox_res_match, "univariate.dfs.cox.RNA.diff.tsv", sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)

write.table(cox_os_res_match, "univariate.os.cox.RNA.diff.tsv", sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)

write.table(multi_cox_res_match, "multivariate.dfs.cox.RNA.diff.tsv", sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)

write.table(multi_cox_os_res_match, "multivariate.os.cox.RNA.diff.tsv", sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)
```

##### find the representative genes for each focal CNV
```{r}
############# select the most significant gene represent the Focal_CNV genes
load(file = "focal_cnv.RData")


os_uni_results <- read.table("univariate.os.cox.focal_cnv.gene.tsv",sep="\t",header=T,check.names=F)
dfs_uni_results <- read.table("univariate.dfs.cox.focal_cnv.gene.tsv",sep="\t",header=T,check.names=F)


focal_cnv_annotation$Gene  <- gsub("-", "_", focal_cnv_annotation$Gene )  
focal_cnv_annotation$Gene  <- gsub(",", ".", focal_cnv_annotation$Gene )  

dfs_uni_results_1 <- merge(focal_cnv_annotation, dfs_uni_results[,c("factor","p_value")], by.x="Gene",by.y="factor", all.x=T) %>%
  mutate(model="DFS")

os_uni_results_1 <- merge(focal_cnv_annotation,
os_uni_results[,c("factor","p.value")],by.x="Gene",by.y="factor", all.x=T) %>%
  rename(p_value=p.value) %>%
  mutate(model="OS")

focal_uni_results <- rbind(dfs_uni_results_1, os_uni_results_1)

focal_uni_results <- focal_uni_results %>%
  group_by(Focal_CNV_id,model) %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value)) %>%
  filter(p_value==min(p_value,na.rm=T)) %>%
  summarise(
    Gene = paste(Gene,collapse=","),
    p_value = first(p_value),
    Focal_CNV_id = first(Focal_CNV_id),
    model = first(model),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

save(focal_uni_results, file="univariate.cox.focal_cnv.unique_gene.RData")
```

```{r}
tab_4_dfs_cox <- Age_selected_scaled[patient_id,] %>%

tab_4_os_cox <- Age_selected_scaled[patient_id,] %>%

colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox))

## check if features in tab or not
dfs_selected_features[!sapply(dfs_selected_features, function(x) x %in% colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox))]
os_selected_features[!sapply(os_selected_features, function(x) x %in% colnames(tab_4_os_cox))]

tab_4_os_sig_cox <- tab_4_os_cox[,colnames(tab_4_os_cox) %in% c("Sample","sur_os",os_selected_features)]

### test highly correlated factors in tab
tab_4_dfs_sig_cox_tmp <- tab_4_dfs_sig_cox %>% select(-Sample,-sur_dfs)
cor_matrix <- cor(tab_4_dfs_sig_cox_tmp, use = "complete.obs")

tab_4_os_sig_cox_tmp <- tab_4_os_sig_cox %>% select(-Sample,-sur_os)

### scale all to Z scores
rownames(tab_4_dfs_sig_cox) <- tab_4_dfs_sig_cox$Sample

  left_join(sur_dat[, c("Sample", "sur_dfs")], by = "Sample")

rownames(tab_4_os_sig_cox) <- tab_4_os_sig_cox$Sample

tab_4_os_sig_cox <- tab_4_os_sig_cox %>%

####re-select significant features to build pronostic models
```

### 1000-times 8:2 sample split (Lasso + split-validation C-index), combine with 435 Sample lasso results KM

##### 435s, 8:2 sample split lasso, for cindex calculation
###### functions for 8:2 sample split (Lasso + split-validation C-index) 
```{r}
cindex_28_fun_os <- function(seed = 1234, tab_4_cox_28 = tab_4_os_sig_cox, test_list = test_os, cox_res_sig = os_sig_features_names){
  res <- tryCatch({
    set.seed(seed)
    train_idx <- sort(sample(c(1:nrow(tab_4_cox_28)),  size = round(nrow(tab_4_cox_28)*0.8)))
    test_idx <- setdiff(c(1:nrow(tab_4_cox_28)), train_idx)
    
    cox_fit_list <- lapply(1:length(test_list), function(i){
      
      set.seed(seed)
      cv.fit_ <- cv.glmnet(x = as.matrix(tab_4_cox_28[ train_idx, cox_res_sig$factor[cox_res_sig$omics %in% test_list[[i]]] ]),
                           y = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ]$sur_os,
                           family="cox", parallel = T, alpha=1)
      fit_ <- glmnet(x = as.matrix(tab_4_cox_28[ train_idx, cox_res_sig$factor[cox_res_sig$omics %in% test_list[[i]]] ]),
                     y = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ]$sur_os,
                     family="cox", alpha=1)
      s_ <- cv.fit_$lambda.min
      lasso_factor <- names(coef(fit_)[,fit_[["lambda"]] == s_] [coef(fit_)[,fit_[["lambda"]] == s_]!=0 ])
      rm(cv.fit_, fit_, s_)
      
      formula = as.formula(paste("sur_os", " ~ ", paste(lasso_factor, collapse = "+") ))
      
      cox_model <- survival::coxph(formula,data = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ])
      list(
        model = cox_model,
        factors = lasso_factor
      )
    })
    
    names(cox_fit_list) <- sapply(test_list, function(i){paste(i, collapse = "+")})
    
    cindx_tab1 <- data.frame(model = names(cox_fit_list),
                             cindex = sapply(cox_fit_list, function(x){
                               survival::concordance(x$model, newdata = tab_4_cox_28[test_idx, ])[[1]]}),
                             seed = seed,
                            factors = sapply(cox_fit_list, function(x){
                              paste(x$factors, collapse = ";")
                            }))
    cindx_tab1
  }, error = function(e){
    cindx_tab1 <- data.frame(model = c(sapply(test_list, function(i){paste(i, collapse = "+")})),cindex = NA,seed = seed,factors=NA)
    cindx_tab1
    message("error messages: ", e$message)
  })
  
  res
  
}

cindex_28_fun_dfs <- function(seed = 1234, tab_4_cox_28 = tab_4_dfs_sig_cox, test_list = test_dfs, cox_res_sig = dfs_sig_features_names){
  res <- tryCatch({
    set.seed(seed)
    train_idx <- sort(sample(c(1:nrow(tab_4_cox_28)),  size = round(nrow(tab_4_cox_28)*0.8)))
    test_idx <- setdiff(c(1:nrow(tab_4_cox_28)), train_idx)
  
    cox_fit_list <- lapply(1:length(test_list), function(i){
      if(i == 1){                        
        cox_model <- survival::coxph(as.formula(paste("sur_dfs", " ~ ", "TNM_Stage" )),
                        data = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ])
        list(
            model = cox_model,
            factors = "TNM_Stage"
          )
        
      } else {
        set.seed(seed)
        cv.fit_ <- cv.glmnet(x = as.matrix(tab_4_cox_28[ train_idx, cox_res_sig$factor[cox_res_sig$omics %in% test_list[[i]]] ]),
                             y = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ]$sur_dfs,
                             family="cox", parallel = T, alpha=1)
        fit_ <- glmnet(x = as.matrix(tab_4_cox_28[ train_idx, cox_res_sig$factor[cox_res_sig$omics %in% test_list[[i]]] ]),
                       y = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ]$sur_dfs,
                       family="cox", alpha=1)
        s_ <- cv.fit_$lambda.min
        lasso_factor <- names(coef(fit_)[,fit_[["lambda"]] == s_] [coef(fit_)[,fit_[["lambda"]] == s_]!=0 ])
        rm(cv.fit_, fit_, s_)
        
        cox_model <- survival::coxph(as.formula(paste("sur_dfs", " ~ ", paste(lasso_factor, collapse = " + ") )),
                        data = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ])
        list(
            model = cox_model,
            factors = lasso_factor
          )
      }
    })
    names(cox_fit_list) <- c(sapply(test_list, function(i){paste(i, collapse = "+")}))
    
    cindx_tab1 <- data.frame(model = names(cox_fit_list),
                             cindex = sapply(cox_fit_list, function(x){
                          survival::concordance(x$model, newdata = tab_4_cox_28[test_idx, ])[[1]]}),
                             seed = seed,
                            factors = sapply(cox_fit_list, function(x){
                              paste(x$factors, collapse = ";")
                            }))
    
    cindx_tab1
  }, error = function(e){
    cindx_tab1 <- data.frame(model = c(sapply(test_list, function(i){paste(i, collapse = "+")})),
                             cindex = NA,
                             seed = seed,
                             factor=NA)
    cindx_tab1
    message("error messages: ", e$message)
  })
  
  res
  
}
```

###### prognostic models
```{r}
load(file="dfs.all_combn.lasso.RData")
load(file="os.all_combn.lasso.RData")
load(file = "model_features.RData")

prognosis_model_fun <- function(seed = 1234, sur_model="",features_combn = c(), input_df=data.frame()){
  
  ############## cox results for all features
  cox_fit_list <- do.call(list, Map(function(i,name){
    print(name)

    set.seed(seed)
    input_df_tmp <- input_df[,c("Sample",i,sur_model)]
    input_df_tmp <- input_df_tmp[complete.cases(input_df_tmp),]
    total_samples <- nrow(input_df_tmp)
    ############# cox results 
    cox_results <- survival::coxph(as.formula(paste(sur_model, " ~ ", paste(i, collapse = " + ") )),data = input_df_tmp)
    c_index <- survival::concordance(cox_results)$concordance
    
    ############# tab_coef
    tab_coef_multi <- as.data.frame(summary(cox_results)[[7]]) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(features = rownames(as.data.frame(summary(cox_results)[[7]]))) %>% 
      dplyr::arrange(desc(coef)) 

    tab_risk_cox <- data.frame(input_df_tmp[, c("Sample", sur_model)],
                               cox_rs = predict(cox_results, type = "risk", newdata = input_df_tmp[, i,drop=FALSE])) %>%
      left_join(chemo_dat[, c("Sample", "chemotherapy")], by = "Sample") %>% 
      left_join(input_df[, c("Sample", "TNM_Stage")], by = "Sample")

    ############# features importance
    wald_tab <- as.data.frame(summary(cox_results)[[7]]) %>% 
      dplyr::filter(is.na(z) == F) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(abs_wald = abs(z))
    wald_tab <- wald_tab %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(factor_name = rownames(wald_tab)) %>% 
      dplyr::select("factor_name", "abs_wald") %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(prop_wald = (`abs_wald`/sum(wald_tab$`abs_wald`))*100) %>% 
      dplyr::arrange(`prop_wald`)
      
    ############# return results
    cindx_tab <- list(
      model = name,
      c_index = c_index,          # C-index
      # cox_results = cox_results,
      tab_coef_multi = tab_coef_multi,
      tab_risk_cox = tab_risk_cox,
      wald_tab = wald_tab,
      features = paste(i, collapse = ", "),
      sample_num = total_samples,
      seed=seed
    )
  
    cindx_tab
    
  },features_combn, names(features_combn))
  )
  cox_fit_list
  
}

## call functions with one seed
prog_model_dfs <- prognosis_model_fun(seed = 1234, sur_model="sur_dfs", features_combn=dfs_lasso_results_list, input_df=tab_4_dfs_sig_cox)

prog_model_os <- prognosis_model_fun(seed = 1234, sur_model="sur_os", features_combn=os_lasso_results_list, input_df=tab_4_os_sig_cox)

save(prog_model_dfs,prognosis_model_fun, file="prog_model_dfs.Rdata")
save(prog_model_os, file="prog_model_os.Rdata")
```

###### chemotherapy KM plots functions
```{r}
plot_km_fun <- function(tab_4_kmplot, title = "", model_name, name, dirname,suffix){
  
  if (!dir.exists(dirname)) {
    dir.create(dirname, recursive = TRUE)
  }
   risk_group <- tab_4_kmplot %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(tab_4_kmplot[,model_name]) == F) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(`cox_rs`) == F) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(risk_group = factor(ifelse(`cox_rs` <= median(`cox_rs`), "Low Risk", "High Risk"), levels = c("Low Risk", "High Risk"))) 
   
  ### High risk
  high_risk <- risk_group %>%
    dplyr::filter(risk_group == "High Risk") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(labs = factor(chemotherapy, levels = c("Non-Chemotherapy", "Chemotherapy"))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(sur = !!sym(model_name)) 
  
  cox_formula <- as.formula("sur ~ labs")
  cox_model <- coxph(cox_formula, data=high_risk)
  cox_res <- summary(cox_model)
  HR <- signif(cox_res$coefficients[1,"exp(coef)"],digits=2)
  HR_lower95 <- signif(cox_res$conf.int[1,"lower .95"],digits=2)
  HR_upper95 <- signif(cox_res$conf.int[1,"upper .95"],digits=2)
  HR_str_high_risk <- paste0("HR = ",HR, " (",HR_lower95," - ",HR_upper95,")")
    
  km_fit_high_risk <- survfit(sur ~ labs, data = high_risk)
  p_val_high_risk <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit_high_risk,data=high_risk)$pval
  formatted_p_high_risk <- sprintf("%.5g", p_val_high_risk)  
  formatted_p_high_risk <- paste0("P = ", formatted_p_high_risk)
  
  ### low risk
  low_risk <- risk_group %>%
    dplyr::filter(risk_group == "Low Risk") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(labs = factor(chemotherapy, levels = c("Non-Chemotherapy", "Chemotherapy"))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(sur = !!sym(model_name)) 
  
  cox_formula <- as.formula("sur ~ labs")
  cox_model <- coxph(cox_formula, data=low_risk)
  cox_res <- summary(cox_model)
  HR <- signif(cox_res$coefficients[1,"exp(coef)"],digits=2)
  HR_lower95 <- signif(cox_res$conf.int[1,"lower .95"],digits=2)
  HR_upper95 <- signif(cox_res$conf.int[1,"upper .95"],digits=2)
  HR_str_low_risk <- paste0("HR = ",HR, " (",HR_lower95," - ",HR_upper95,")")
  
  km_fit_low_risk <- survfit(sur ~ labs, data = low_risk)
  p_val_low_risk <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit_low_risk,data=low_risk)$pval
  formatted_p_low_risk <- sprintf("%.5g", p_val_low_risk)  
  formatted_p_low_risk <- paste0("P = ", formatted_p_low_risk)
  
  ### counts of patients
  high_risk_counts <- table(high_risk$labs)
  high_risk_che_count <- high_risk_counts["Chemotherapy"][[1]]
  high_risk_nonche_count <- high_risk_counts["Non-Chemotherapy"][[1]]
  
  low_risk_counts <- table(low_risk$labs)
  low_risk_che_count <- low_risk_counts["Chemotherapy"]
  low_risk_nonche_count <- low_risk_counts["Non-Chemotherapy"]
  
  if (model_name=="sur_dfs") {
    ylabel = "DFS"
  } else if(model_name=="sur_os"){
    ylabel = "OS"
  }
  
  p1 <- ggsurvplot(km_fit_high_risk, 
           data = high_risk,
           pval = FALSE,     
           risk.table = FALSE,    
           conf.int = FALSE,     
           palette = c("#E41A1C","#377EB8" ), 
           title = paste0(suffix," (High-risk)"),
           tables.y.text = FALSE,
           xlab = "Time (Months)", 
           ylab = ylabel,
           legend = c(0.38,0.35),
           legend.title = "",
           legend.labs=c(paste0("Non-Chemotherapy (n=", high_risk_nonche_count,")"),
                         paste0("Chemotherapy (n=", high_risk_che_count, ")"))
           ) 
  plot1 <- p1$plot + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.15, label = formatted_p_high_risk, size = 5, hjust = 0)
  plot1 <- plot1 + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.05, label = HR_str_high_risk, size = 5, hjust = 0)
  
  
  p2 <- ggsurvplot(km_fit_low_risk, 
           data = low_risk,
           pval = FALSE,     
           risk.table = FALSE,    # 添加风险表
           conf.int = FALSE,      # 显示置信区间
           palette = c( "#E41A1C","#377EB8"), 
           title = paste0(suffix," (Low-risk)"),
           tables.y.text = FALSE,
           xlab = "Time (Months)", 
           ylab = ylabel,
           legend = c(0.38,0.35),
           legend.title = "",
           legend.labs=c(paste0("Non-Chemotherapy (n=", low_risk_nonche_count,")"),
                         paste0("Chemotherapy (n=", low_risk_che_count, ")")
                         )
           )
  plot2 <- p2$plot + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.15, label = formatted_p_low_risk, size = 5, hjust = 0)
  plot2 <- plot2 + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.05, label = HR_str_low_risk, size = 5, hjust = 0)
  
  
  file_name = paste0(dirname, model_name,".",gsub("\\s*\\+\\s*", "_", name),".",suffix, ".chemo_KM_plot.pdf" )

  combined_plot <- plot_grid(plot1, plot2, ncol = 2)
  
  ggsave(combined_plot, file=file_name,device="pdf", width=8, height=4)
  output_file <- paste0(dirname, model_name,".","chemo_KM_results.", suffix, ".tsv")
  
  if (!file.exists(output_file)) {
    write.table(
      data.frame(
        model = character(),
        p_val_high_risk = character(),
        p_val_low_risk = character()
      ),
      file = output_file,
      sep = "\t",
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = TRUE,
      quote = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  write.table(
    data.frame(
      model = name,
      p_val_high_risk = p_val_high_risk,
      p_val_low_risk = p_val_low_risk
    ),
    file = output_file,
    sep = "\t",
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE,
    append = TRUE
  )
}

save(plot_km_fun, file = "chemo_KM_plot.functions.template.Rdata")
```

###### KM plots functions
```{r}
plot_km_fun <- function(tab_4_kmplot, title = "", model_name, name, dirname, suffix){
  if (!dir.exists(dirname)) {
    dir.create(dirname, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  aa <- tab_4_kmplot %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(tab_4_kmplot[,model_name]) == F) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(`cox_rs`) == F) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(labs = factor(ifelse(`cox_rs` <= median(`cox_rs`), "Low Risk", "High Risk"), levels = c("Low Risk", "High Risk"))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(sur = !!sym(model_name)) 
  
  cox_formula <- as.formula("sur ~ labs")
  cox_model <- coxph(cox_formula, data=aa)
  cox_res <- summary(cox_model)
  HR <- cox_res$coefficients[1,"exp(coef)"]
  HR_lower95 <- cox_res$conf.int[1,"lower .95"]
  HR_upper95 <- cox_res$conf.int[1,"upper .95"]
  HR_str <- paste0(HR,"= (",HR_lower95," - ",HR_upper95,")")
    
  km_fit <- survfit(sur ~ labs, data = aa)
  p_val <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit,data=aa)$pval
  formatted_p <- sprintf("%.5g", p_val)
  formatted_p <- paste0("P = ", formatted_p)

  risk_counts <- table(aa$labs)
  low_risk_count <- risk_counts["Low Risk"]
  high_risk_count <- risk_counts["High Risk"]
  
  if (model_name=="sur_dfs") {
    ylabel = "DFS"
  } else if(model_name=="sur_os"){
    ylabel = "OS"
  }
  
  p1 <- ggsurvplot(km_fit, 
           data = aa,
           pval = FALSE,     
           risk.table = TRUE,   
           conf.int = FALSE,     
           palette = c("#377EB8", "#E41A1C"), 
           title = title,
           tables.y.text = FALSE,
           xlab = "Time (Months)", 
           ylab = ylabel,
           ggtheme = theme_classic() + theme(
             plot.title = element_text(size=8)
           ),
           legend = c(0.38,0.35),
           legend.title = "",
           legend.labs=c(paste0("Low-risk (n = ",low_risk_count, ")"),
                         paste0("High-risk (n=", high_risk_count,")"))
           ) 

  plot <- p1$plot + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.1, label = formatted_p, size = 5, hjust = 0)
  
  return(list(plot=plot, p_val=p_val, risk_group=aa))
}

save(plot_km_fun, file = "KM_plot.functions.template.Rdata")

### all patients
KM_plot_fuc_stage_all <- function(model_list, name, model_name,dirname,suffix) {
  print(name)
  tryCatch({
    tab_risk_cox_tmp <- model_list$tab_risk_cox
    
    result <- plot_km_fun(tab_4_kmplot = tab_risk_cox_tmp, title = paste0(name," ",suffix), model_name = model_name, name=name,dirname=dirname,suffix=suffix)
    
    ### high-low risk sample groups
    high_risk_group <- result$risk_group %>%
      filter(labs=="High Risk")
    high_risk_group_samples <- paste(high_risk_group$Sample, collapse=",")
    low_risk_group <- result$risk_group %>%
      filter(labs=="Low Risk")
    low_risk_group_samples <- paste(low_risk_group$Sample, collapse=",")
  
    file_name = paste0(dirname,model_name,".",gsub("\\s*\\+\\s*", "_", name),".",suffix, ".KM_plot.pdf" )
    ggsave(result$plot, file=file_name,device="pdf", width=4, height=4)
    
    output_file <- paste0(dirname, model_name,".","KM_results.", suffix, ".tsv")
    if (!file.exists(output_file)) {
      write.table(
        data.frame(
          model = character(),
          p_val = character(),
          high_risk_samples = character(),
          low_risk_samples = character()
        ),
        file = output_file,
        sep = "\t",
        row.names = FALSE,
        col.names = TRUE,
        quote = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    write.table(
      data.frame(
        model = name,
        p_val = result$p_val,
        high_risk_samples = high_risk_group_samples,
        low_risk_samples = low_risk_group_samples
      ),
      file = output_file,sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE,col.names = FALSE,quote = FALSE,append = TRUE)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error:", e$message))
  })
}

### stages
KM_plot_fuc_stage_split <- function(model_list, name, model_name,dirname,suffix="") {
  print(name)
  output_df <- data.frame()
  ###### stage 1
  tryCatch({
  tab_risk_cox_tmp <- model_list$tab_risk_cox %>%
    dplyr::filter(`TNM_Stage` %in% c(0/3))
  result1 <- plot_km_fun(tab_4_kmplot = tab_risk_cox_tmp, title = paste0(name," Stage-I"), model_name = model_name, name=name,dirname=dirname,suffix="Stage-I")
  output_df[name, "Stage-I_KM_pvalue"] = result1$p_val
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in Stage-I:", e$message))
  })
  
  ###### stage 2
  tryCatch({
  tab_risk_cox_tmp <- model_list$tab_risk_cox %>%
    dplyr::filter(`TNM_Stage` %in% c(1/3))
  result2 <- plot_km_fun(tab_4_kmplot = tab_risk_cox_tmp, title = paste0(name," Stage-II"), model_name = model_name, name=name,dirname=dirname,suffix="Stage-II")
  output_df[name, "Stage-II_KM_pvalue"] = result2$p_val
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in Stage-II:", e$message))
  })
  
  ###### stage 3
  tryCatch({
  tab_risk_cox_tmp <- model_list$tab_risk_cox %>%
    dplyr::filter(`TNM_Stage` %in% c(2/3))
  result3 <- plot_km_fun(tab_4_kmplot = tab_risk_cox_tmp, title = paste0(name," Stage-III"), model_name = model_name, name=name,dirname=dirname,suffix="Stage-III")
  output_df[name, "Stage-III_KM_pvalue"] = result3$p_val
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in Stage-III:", e$message))
  })
  
  ###### stage 4
  tryCatch({
  tab_risk_cox_tmp <- model_list$tab_risk_cox %>%
    dplyr::filter(`TNM_Stage` %in% c(3/3))
  result4 <- plot_km_fun(tab_4_kmplot = tab_risk_cox_tmp, title = paste0(name," Stage-IV"), model_name = model_name, name=name, dirname=dirname,suffix="Stage-IV")
  output_df[name, "Stage-IV_KM_pvalue"] = result4$p_val
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in Stage-IV:", e$message))
  })
  
  tryCatch({
    ### combine plots
    file_name = paste0(dirname,model_name,".",gsub("\\s*\\+\\s*", "_", name),".split_stage.KM_plot.pdf" )
    combined_plot <- plot_grid(result1$plot, result2$plot,result3$plot, result4$plot, ncol = 4)
    ggsave(combined_plot, file=file_name,device="pdf", width=16, height=4)
    
    output_file <- paste0(dirname, model_name,".","KM_results.split_stage.tsv")
    if (!file.exists(output_file)) {
      write.table(
        data.frame(
          model = character(),
          "Stage-I_KM_pvalue" = character(),
          "Stage-II_KM_pvalue" = character(),
          "Stage-III_KM_pvalue" = character(),
          "Stage-IV_KM_pvalue" = character()
        ),
        file = output_file, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
    }
    
    write.table(output_df, file = output_file, sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, append = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in output_df:", e$message))
  })
}

## stage 2&3
KM_plot_fuc_stage_23 <- function(model_list, name, model_name,dirname,suffix="") {

  output_df <- data.frame()
  
  ###### stage 2&3
  tryCatch({
  tab_risk_cox_tmp <- model_list$tab_risk_cox %>%
    dplyr::filter(`TNM_Stage` %in% c(2, 3))
  result3 <- plot_km_fun(tab_4_kmplot = tab_risk_cox_tmp, title = paste0(name," Stage-II&III"), model_name = model_name, name=name,dirname=dirname,suffix="Stage-II&III")
  output_df[name, "Stage-II&III_KM_pvalue"] = result3$p_val
  risk_group <- result3$risk_group
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in Stage-II&III:", e$message))
  })
  
  tryCatch({
    ### combine plots
    file_name = paste0(dirname, model_name,".",gsub("\\s*\\+\\s*", "_", name),".split_stage.KM_plot.pdf" )
    combined_plot <- plot_grid(result3$plot, ncol = 1)
    ggsave(combined_plot, file=file_name,device="pdf", width=8, height=8)
    
    output_file <- paste0(dirname, model_name,".","KM_results.II&III.tsv")
    output_risk_file <- paste0(dirname, model_name,".",gsub("\\s*\\+\\s*", "_", name),".risk_group.II&III.tsv")
    if (!file.exists(output_file)) {
      write.table(
        data.frame(
          model = character(),
          "Stage-II&III_KM_pvalue" = character()
        ),
        file = output_file, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
    }
    
    write.table(output_df, file = output_file, sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, append = TRUE)
    write.table(risk_group, file = output_risk_file, sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in output_df:", e$message))
  })
}

save(KM_plot_fuc_stage_all, KM_plot_fuc_stage_split, KM_plot_fuc_stage_23, file = "KM_plot.functions.map_models.template.Rdata")
```

```{r}
load(file="00.plot_input.Rdata")

### dfs plots
p_compare_dfs <- cindex_28_1000res_dfs %>% 
  ggviolin(x = "model",  y = "cindex", fill = "model",color="white",
            # palette = c(color_vec, "Intergation" = "#000000"),
            xlab = F , ylab = "C-Index", outlier.size = 1, 
           width = 0.8, size = 0.2,alpha=0.3
            )+ 
  geom_boxplot(width=0.2, color="black", alpha=1, fill = "white", lwd=0.2, outlier.shape = NA)+ 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.7,linetype="dashed",size=0.2,color="grey") + 
  rotate_x_text(90)+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0.5, 0.7, 0.9))+
  labs(title = "DFS Multivariate Cox Models Performance")+
  theme(legend.position = "right", 
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold", family = "Arial"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, family = "Arial"),

        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())+
  # scale_fill_npg() +  
  # scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  # scale_fill_igv() + 
  guides(fill = FALSE, color=FALSE)

p_compare_dfs

### dfs heatmap

ht_input_dfs <- combine_input_dfs[rownames(combine_input_dfs) %in% c("dfs_Stage_I_KM_pvalue","dfs_Stage_II_KM_pvalue","dfs_Stage_III_KM_pvalue","dfs_Stage_IV_KM_pvalue"),]
rownames(ht_input_dfs) <- c("Stage I","Stage II","Stage III","Stage IV")


ht_input_dfs_out <- data.frame(t(ht_input_dfs),check.names=F)
write.table(ht_input_dfs_out, "KM_pvalues.DFS.tsv", row.names = T, quote=F,sep="\t")


add_stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return(0)
  
  p_val_threshold <- -log10(0.05)  

  n_stars <- 0
  if (p > p_val_threshold) n_stars <- 1
  if (p > 2)             n_stars <- 2
  if (p > 3)             n_stars <- 3
  if (p > 4)             n_stars <- 4
  
  return(n_stars) 
}

### add stars### add stars
star_matrix_dfs <- matrix(nrow = nrow(ht_input_dfs), ncol = ncol(ht_input_dfs))
for (i in 1:nrow(ht_input_dfs)) {
  for (j in 1:ncol(ht_input_dfs)) {
    star_matrix_dfs[i, j] <- add_stars(ht_input_dfs[i, j])
  }
}
rownames(star_matrix_dfs) <- rownames(ht_input_dfs)
colnames(star_matrix_dfs) <- colnames(ht_input_dfs)
### color palette
my_palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","#D73120"))(100)
n_rows <- nrow(ht_input_dfs)

### heatmap
heatmap_dfs <- Heatmap(ht_input_dfs, 
                   col = my_palette, 
                   cluster_columns = FALSE, 
                   cluster_rows = FALSE,
                   column_order = names(mean_cindex_dfs),
                   cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                      n_stars = star_matrix_dfs[i, j]
                      if (n_stars > 0) {
                        star_pacing <- 0.15
                        star_size <- 0.8
                        total_stack_len <- (n_stars - 1) * star_pacing * height
                        start_y <- y - total_stack_len/2
                        for (k in 1:n_stars) {
                          star_y <- start_y + (k - 1) * star_pacing * height
                          grid.text("*", x=x, y=star_y,
                                    gp = gpar(fontsize=8*star_size,
                                              col = "black"))
                        }
                      }
                   },
                   na_col = "grey95",
                   heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "-log10(p)"),
                   row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),  
                    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6), 
                    height = unit(2.5, "cm") )

ht_grob <- grid.grabExpr(draw(heatmap_dfs, heatmap_legend_side = "right"))
blank_plot <- ggplot() + theme_void() 

final_plot <- grid.arrange(
  arrangeGrob(p_compare_dfs, blank_plot, ncol = 2, widths = c(85, 15)),
  # arrangeGrob(p_bar, blank_plot,ncol = 2, widths=c(96,4)),
  arrangeGrob(blank_plot, ht_grob,  ncol = 2, widths = c(6, 94)),
  nrow = 2,
  heights = c(2,8) 
)

final_ggplot <- as_ggplot(final_plot)  
final_ggplot
ggsave("dfs.lambda_min.c_index_htmap.pdf", final_ggplot, width = 8, height = 7,limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r}
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold", family = "Arial"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8, family = "Arial"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6, family = "Arial"),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line=element_line(linewidth =0.2)
        )+
  guides(fill = FALSE)
p_compare_os

### os heatmap
## input
# ht_input_os <- combine_input_os[-1,]
## input
ht_input_os <- combine_input_os[rownames(combine_input_os) %in% c("os_Stage_I_KM_pvalue","os_Stage_II_KM_pvalue","os_Stage_III_KM_pvalue","os_Stage_IV_KM_pvalue"),]
rownames(ht_input_os) <- c("Stage I","Stage II","Stage III","Stage IV")


ht_input_os_out <- data.frame(t(ht_input_os),check.names=F)
write.table(ht_input_os_out, "KM_pvalues.OS.tsv", row.names = T, quote=F,sep="\t")


### add stars function
add_stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")  
  if (p > 4) return("*\n*\n*\n*")
  if (p > 3) return("*\n*\n*")
  if (p > 2) return("*\n*")
  if (p > -log10(0.05)) return("*")
  return("")  
}

### add stars### add stars
star_matrix_os <- matrix(nrow = nrow(ht_input_os), ncol = ncol(ht_input_os))
for (i in 1:nrow(ht_input_os)) {
  for (j in 1:ncol(ht_input_os)) {
    star_matrix_os[i, j] <- add_stars(ht_input_os[i, j])
  }
}
rownames(star_matrix_os) <- rownames(ht_input_os)
colnames(star_matrix_os) <- colnames(ht_input_os)
### color palette
my_palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","#D73120"))(100)
n_rows <- nrow(ht_input_os)


### heatmap
heatmap_os <- Heatmap(ht_input_os, 
                   col = my_palette, 
                   cluster_columns = FALSE, 
                   cluster_rows = FALSE,
                   column_order = names(mean_cindex_os),
                   cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                      stars <- star_matrix_os[i, j]
                      if (stars != "") {
                        grid.text(stars, x = x, y = y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 4, col = "black"))
                      }
                    },
                   heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "-log10(p)",
                                               grid_height=unit(1, "cm"),
                                               title_gp = gpar(fontsize=8),
                                               labels_gp = gpar(fontsize=8)
                                               ),
                   row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6), 
                    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4),  
                    height = unit(n_rows * 0.8, "cm") )

ht_grob <- grid.grabExpr(draw(heatmap_os, heatmap_legend_side = "right"))
blank_plot <- ggplot() + theme_void() 

final_plot <- grid.arrange(
  arrangeGrob(p_compare_os, blank_plot, ncol = 2, widths = c(75, 25)),
  arrangeGrob(blank_plot, ht_grob,  ncol = 2, widths = c(12, 88)),
  nrow = 2,
  heights = c(2,7) 
)

final_ggplot <- as_ggplot(final_plot)  
final_ggplot
ggsave("os.lambda_min.c_index_htmap.pdf", final_ggplot, width = 4, height = 6,limitsize = FALSE)
```
